label: Bridgehollow (legacy)
description: The names the town generator used before naming sets existed. Applied automatically to places whose id starts with 'bridgehollow' and have no naming_set, so the committed Bridgehollow data regenerates byte-identical. New places use another set.

district_notes.civic: Wardens, court, tax office and lockup on the low rise.
district_notes.residential: Commoners' homes and trades around the centre.
district_notes.farm: Fields and farmsteads feathering out toward the hills.

hall.name: Warden's Hall
hall.notes: Seat of the wardens, on the low rise. Layout proposed.

tax.name: Tax and Permit Office
tax.notes: Tolls, permits and levies, first stop on the road into the centre.

lockup.name: Lockup
lockup.notes: Cells, kept beside the warden's hall.

meeting.name: Meeting Hall
meeting.notes: Plain hall for town meetings; no religious use.

smithy.name: Smithy
smithy.notes: Forge near water, away from the thatched core.

mill.name: Mill
mill.notes: Water mill on the river bank (mill-race site; slope limit relaxed 1.6x for the bank).
